ZinStdThread.Purpose: High-level thread lifecycle API built above target thread primitives and the core atomic/TLS memory model.
ZinStdThread.Join: join waits for thread completion. A thread handle owns target thread resources until joined/detached.
ZinStdThread.Detach: detach transfers cleanup responsibility to the runtime/OS and invalidates join on that handle.
ZinStdThread.Allocation: Any allocation used for thread stacks or control blocks must be explicit through allocator or explicitly named OS primitives.
ZinStdThread.Errors: Spawn/join errors are ordinary Zin error unions; thread failures are not exceptions.
